Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

parallels.note: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

people.name: Beth-haccherem
people.line: Town in Judah, possibly fortified, mentioned by Jeremiah.

people.name: Dung_Gate
people.line: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, possibly used for waste removal.

people.name: Malchijah
people.line: Son of Rechab, repaired the Dung Gate in Jerusalem.

people.name: Rechab
people.line: Father of Malchijah, who repaired the Dung Gate

translations.web: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
translations.bsb: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malchijah son of Rechab, ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem. He rebuilt it and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.
translations.kjv: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Bethhaccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars
translations.asv: And the dung gate repaired Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the bolts thereof, and the bars thereof.
